usage.finalMessage:
I removed the rejected DEC-W-8 change: the L01 test is back to its original assertions, and DEC-W-8 is marked rejected (commit `83952f4`). The L13 work under DEC-W-1 to DEC-W-7 is still in place.
`dotnet test` now gives 18 passed, 1 failed. The failure is L01's `member` test: L01-R3 and L13-R1 require different output for the same command, so both can't pass.
The Head of Lending owns both requirements and needs to revise L01-R3 or grant an approval; this is recorded in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: blocked - LEND-L01-R3 and LEND-L13-R1 conflict on the `member` output; the L01 test update (DEC-W-8) was rejected, so 1 of 19 tests fails until the Head of Lending revises L01-R3 or grants an approval
